1791 source sheet: Passau on the south edge of its main territory; Oberhaus/Hauzenberg/Obernzell in the southern body, Waldkirchen and Wolfstein/Freyung northward; neighbouring Bavaria westward, Bohemia northward, Upper Austria eastward.

Independent territorial prose confirms temporal Abteiland, Hals under Bavarian sovereignty and separate Rent-/Waldguetleramt. It dates the eastern revision to 1765; does not authorize all the Muehlviertel.
Current parent connectivity supports splitting the long north-south xB08021 instead of transferring its full 252 cells or all State 71.
Schematic boundaries intentionally round and shorten the engraved jurisdiction shapes. No city-radius selection, no averaged translation, no city-locator GCP and no new hydrographic fit.

common_exclusions.meaning: Western/northwestern approach retained in Bavaria as an exclusion sector for Hals and neighbouring Bavarian land; not a certified pixel outline or a newly created one-cell Hals enclave.
No southern bridge or corridor; Rent-/Waldguetleramt, St Nikola and Neuburg need a separate treatment. This box is a screening sector, not their exact borders.
